employees.basis: Company employees (corporate and other offices and Company-owned and operated restaurants), stated as 'over 150,000'

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 People
source.quote: Company employees, which include those in the Company's corporate and other offices as well as in Company-owned and operated restaurants, totaled over 150,000 worldwide as of year-end 2025, of which approximately 70% were based outside of the U.S.

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO pay ratio
source.quote: Our median employee for 2025 is a restaurant crew employee located in Poland and in 2025 had total compensation of $19,020 as calculated in accordance with the Summary Compensation Table rules.

notes: Employees: the 10-K gives a floor ('over 150,000'), recorded as 150,000; it excludes the over two million people who work in franchised restaurants. Payroll: the income statement's 'Payroll & employee benefits' (2,905 million) covers only Company-owned and operated restaurants (support-staff payroll sits in SG&A), so it is not a total staff cost and the proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used: a part-time-inclusive restaurant crew employee in Poland, identified by annualizing one month's wages for employees on October 1, 2025 (CEO pay ratio 1,082:1).
